tenant=spider_advertising_agencies
tables:

      agency_id: int — agency id

      sic_code: str — sic code values: 'Bad', 'Mutual'
      client_details: str — client details

      invoice_id: int — invoice id
      client_id: int — client id
      invoice_status: str — invoice status values: 'Finish', 'Starting', 'Working'
      invoice_details: str — invoice details values: 'excellent', 'good', 'ok'
  - Meetings
      meeting_id: int — meeting id
      client_id: int — client id
      meeting_outcome: str — meeting outcome values: 'Report', 'Summary', 'Vote results'
      meeting_type: str — meeting type values: 'Company', 'Group', 'Team'
      billable_yn: str — billable yn values: '0', '1'
      start_date_time: str — start date time
      end_date_time: str — end date time
      purpose_of_meeting: str — purpose of meeting values: 'get proposal done', 'monthly report', 'vote for solutions', 'weekly report'
      other_details: str — other details
  - Payments
      payment_id: int — payment id
      invoice_id: int — invoice id
      payment_details: str — payment details values: 'American Express', 'Discover Card', 'MasterCard', 'Visa'
  - Staff
      staff_id: int — staff id
      agency_id: int — agency id
      staff_details: str — staff details
  - Staff_in_Meetings
      meeting_id: int — meeting id
      staff_id: int — staff id
